• It has an **ether-like odor.**
 
• It is used as a solvent and in the production of refrigerant freon.
 
• It appears as a **clear colorless liquid.**
 
• It is **denser than water** and **slightly soluble in water.**

• **Used as a solvent**, to make other chemicals, as a fumigant.

• **Sodium chloride **is the common salt.
 
• Its formula is** NaCl.**

• They are white crystals that do not have an odour but possess a taste.
 
• In its aqueous state NaCl acts as a** good conductor of electricity **due to the free movement of the ions.
 
 
 
• **Ethyl chloride**
 
 
• **Ethyl chloride** is a **colorless mobile liquid below 54oF (12oC),** and above this boiling point.

• It is **highly volatile, flammable, and has a sweet odor.**
 
• It is a **versatile, organic compound** used in a variety of applications.

questions.question: The reflection on a bathroom mirror, the lake, and the glare on a pair of glasses are caused by which type of reflection?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Specular reflection**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reflection on a bathroom mirror, the lake, and the glare on a pair of glasses are caused by **Specular reflection.**
 
• **Specular reflection** reflects all light which arrives from a given direction at the same angle, whereas diffuse reflection reflects light in a broad range of directions.
 
• The distinction may be illustrated with surfaces coated with **glossy paint and matte paint**.
 
• Measurement of **specular reflection** is performed with normal or varying incidence reflection spectrophotometers (reflectometer) using a scanning variable-wavelength light source.
 
• Lower quality measurements using a **glossmeter** quantify the glossy appearance of a surface in gloss units.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Multiple reflection **of light is the reflection of light back and forth several times between reflecting surfaces.
 
• **Glossy surfaces** are actually specular surfaces with micro surfaces at angles to surface plane. These micro surfaces reflect light not only specularly but also diffusely, giving the surface a glossy appearance.
 
• **Diffuse reflection** is the reflection of light or other waves or particles from a surface such that a ray incident on the surface is scattered at many angles rather than at just one angle as in the case of specular reflection.

questions.question: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution divides the power between the Centre and the state in terms of the union, state and concurrent list?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Seventh Schedule.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The Seventh Schedule to the Constitution of India defines and specifies allocation of powers and functions between Union & States
 
• It contains three lists; i.e. 1) Union List, 2) State List and 3) Concurrent List. 
 
• Originally there was 97 subjects in union list but now it is 100 subjects in union list.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Ninth Schedule was brought in the Indian Constitution on 18 June 1951 to abolish the Zamindari system. 
 
• The third Schedule contains the “Forms of Oaths or Affirmations” of various constitutional posts. 
 
• The Fifth Schedule of the Constitution deals with the administration and control of Scheduled Areas as well as of Scheduled Tribes residing in any State other than the States of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram.
